verdict.rationale: Supabase's docs say the official CLI can 'run the entire Supabase stack locally, on your machine or in a CI environment.' The workflow is `supabase init` plus `supabase start`, and the local stack even exposes the MCP server at localhost:54321. Hands-on probes confirm the CLI installs and scaffolds a project headlessly with no login. Community users call local development and migrations a rough, bug-prone weak spot, but they report quality problems rather than the capability failing, so this lowers quality without creating a dispute. Missing for 10: no hands-on evidence of `supabase start` bringing up every service, and no independent corroboration that local development is stable and matches production.
